name: Café Jurado
description: Coffee roaster and seller in Uruguay with an online store on WooCommerce. Sells whole-bean, ground and capsule coffee compatible with Nespresso and Lavazza Blue, plus coffee makers and accessories. States shipping to any department for a fixed fee in 24 to 48 hours, and free pickup in Montevideo.
description_es: Tostadora y vendedora de café en Uruguay con tienda online en WooCommerce. Vende café en grano, molido y en cápsulas compatibles con Nespresso y Lavazza Blue, además de cafeteras y accesorios. Indica envío a cualquier departamento por un costo fijo en 24 a 48 horas, y retiro gratis en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Ships to any department for a fixed fee (UYU 180) in 24 to 48 hours.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup in Montevideo at Carrasco, Pocitos and Tres Cruces points.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping fee and time, pickup points, categories
